notes.title: Major update 1.3
notes.content:
[*] New level soundtrack boss and enemies
[*] Controller support
[*] All graphics have been updated
[*] Game rebalanced
[*] Bestiary
[*] New status effects

notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:

- 3 new achievements
- 2 new soundtracks
- Added fullscreen and window resizing
Fixed a bug where achievements would crash the game.

- Fixed a bug where steam achievements would not load.
